headline: Ameriprise Financial Inc's Dividend Analysis
summary: Ameriprise Financial Inc (NYSE:AMP) recently announced a total dividend of $1.7 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-03.  This includes a $1.7 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-08-21.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
